description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Regulation of Insurance Industry Act. No.43 of 2000.
reasoning: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Regulation of Insurance Industry Act, No. 43 of 2000. It amends existing insurance regulations regarding annual fees payable to the Insurance Regulatory Commission. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements for the insurance industry, rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
